IAS Officer Warns Actors Over Pan Masala Endorsements

IAS officer Tukaram Mundhe has issued a warning to actors Shah Rukh Khan, Ajay Devgn, and Tiger Shroff regarding their endorsements of pan masala products. Mundhe stated that being a star does not exempt individuals from adhering to the law. The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Commissioner's comments come amid controversy surrounding these celebrity endorsements, with Mundhe asserting that legal consequences will apply regardless of celebrity status.
